answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: every new agent must lock a saffron stake into a shared lagoon of peer attestations, earning trust only after its work is publicly graded over time. A sybil spawning a nebula of fake identities must fund each one separately, so the attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes while an honest agent amortizes one bond across many jobs. Forged reputations collapse because the ledger is public and the bond is slashed on fraud.
